SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-05-2018 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF HALL, ARCHIE LUMPKIN, FREDERICK RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT MOORE, RENE THOMAS $2,800.00 PRINCIPAL, $50.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,850.00, MOORE'S CLAIM ABOUT THE PLUMBING REPAIR & STORAGE WORK HE DID WERE ADDRESSED IN OTHER CASES. THIS CASE CONCERNS ONLY BACK RENT. MOORE PRODUCED MONEY ORDER STUBS FOR 8/17 THROUGH 11/17. THE COURT AWARDS BACK RENT FOR 6/17 - 7/17 AND 12/17 - 4/18.
